end.summary:
Practised taking out a common factor using division of each term.
Practised factorising x² + px + q by finding two numbers with the given sum and product.
Correctly formed factor pairs for sums/products including (-3, 5) and (-3, -4).
The coefficient-copying mix-up for x² + 5x + 6 appeared twice and was corrected later with (x + 2)(x + 3).
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised taking out common factors and choosing two numbers by checking both their sum and product. The method of copying the visible coefficients into the brackets came up again, but it was corrected later by using 2 and 3 for x² + 5x + 6. At home, ask Arjun to factorise three expressions and write the required sum and product beside each one before choosing the pair.
